**Brand Board (LOCKED):** ./CLAUDE.md §4 — four colors only (Bone, Onyx, Stone, Rust), Inter + Instrument Serif + JetBrains Mono only, four brand rules, no Tailwind default shadows, custom shadow tokens only.
**Schema (shipped):** `supabase/migrations/20260428100000_s13_flash_inventory.sql`

## Your scope — internal app ONLY

Single route: `/portfolio?mode=flash|portfolio` (URL state).

Components in plan §5:
- `PortfolioPageClient` (top-level)
- `ModeToggle` (Flash ↔ Portfolio pill)
- `SavedViewsRow` (All / Available / Reserved / Sold / One-of-one + + New view)
- `PortfolioToolbar` (search + style/status/placement/artist/sort/density)
- `FlashCard` + `PortfolioCard`
- `DetailPanel` → `FlashDetail` + `PortfolioDetail` (4-stage progression strip)
- `UploadDialog` → `UploadFormFlash` (7 sections per PDF §02-iv) + `UploadFormPortfolio` (3 sections + photo-progression slots + Pull-from-Session selector)
- `PullFromSessionDialog`
- `EmptyState` (database-empty + filter-empty)
- `WallView` (full-bleed iPad/front-desk grid)

## Deliverable

ONE markdown file at:
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/docs/sprint-13-portfolio-page-design.md`

For EACH component above, spec:

1. **Anatomy** — sections top→bottom with token references (no hex literals, only `text-onyx`, `bg-bone`, `text-stone`, `border-stone/20`, `shadow-card`, etc — names only).
2. **States** — default / hover / active / disabled / loading / error / empty.
3. **Responsive** — desktop (≥1280) / tablet (768-1279) / mobile (<768). What stacks, what hides, what becomes a sheet.
4. **Accessibility** — keyboard nav order, focus rings, ARIA labels for icon-only buttons, screen-reader copy for status badges.
5. **Motion** — only what's allowed: panel slide (250ms ease-out), hover lift (150ms ease-out), bulk-progress fade. No spinners on idle. No carousel autoplay.
6. **Composition** with shadcn primitives — name them: `<Sheet>` for detail panel, `<Dialog>` for upload, `<Tabs>` for mode toggle, `<Popover>` + `<Command>` for filters, `<DropdownMenu>` for card hover quick-actions.
7. **Status badge variants** — explicit token map per plan §6:
   - Available: outlined Bone bg + Onyx border + Onyx label
   - Reserved: filled Onyx 60% bg + Bone label
   - Sold: filled Onyx bg + Bone label + image desaturate
   - 1/1: top-right, Inter 700 11px uppercase tracking-0.08em, Onyx text on Bone outline
   - Featured: top-right star glyph, Rust (the only Rust per card)
8. **Card hover quick-actions** — Edit / Duplicate / Copy URL / Archive — overlay placement, keyboard shortcut shown on hover.
9. **Detail panel layout** — match plan §6 exactly. Photo progression strip = 4 thumbnails (Reference / Stencil / Fresh / Healed), missing stage = ghost placeholder with `+ Add` button.
10. **Upload form section breakdown** — match PDF §02-iv 7 sections (IMAGE / BASIC / PRICING / STYLE / ONE-OF-ONE / SHEET / VISIBILITY) for flash, 3 sections + progression slots + Pull-from-Session for portfolio. AI auto-tag pre-fill UX: tags appear with "AI suggested" pill that owner accepts or edits.

## Critical constraints — REJECT YOUR OWN DRAFT IF:

- Any color outside Bone / Onyx / Stone / Rust.
- Multiple Rust accents per viewport.
- Italic on body, labels, or numbers.
- Default Tailwind shadow used (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, etc).
- Card uses gradient or frosted glass.
- KPI-style stat cards anywhere (this is not the dashboard).
- Status badge uses any color (badges = bone/onyx variants only — Rust is for featured + destructive only).
- Empty state uses an illustration or shrug emoji.
- Side panel slides from any direction other than right.
- Detail view is a centered modal (PDF says SIDE PANEL — that's locked).

## Voice (Quill aligned, in microcopy):
- "+ Upload" not "Add new" or "Create"
- "Reserve" / "Approve" / "Pin" / "Archive" — verbs, no marketing
- Empty (db): *"Upload your first piece."* + *"Start with a single flash design, or auto-pull from a completed session."*
- Empty (filter): *"No items match these filters."* + buttons "Clear filters" / "Edit view"

## Process

1. Read plan, ./CLAUDE.md §4 (Brand v1.0), ./CLAUDE.md §5 (UI Philosophy), §6 (Voice).
2. Read existing `app/(app)/portfolio/page.tsx` + the gallery component it imports — your spec replaces this.
3. Read existing reusable patterns Koda will reuse: `components/ui/sheet.tsx`, `components/ui/dialog.tsx`, `components/clients/ClientDialog.tsx` (side-panel parallel), `components/shared/StyleTagPicker` (multi-select pattern).
4. Read `app/globals.css` `@theme inline` block to confirm exact token names available (especially `text-page-title`, `text-display`, `text-kpi`, `text-h2`, `text-label`, all `shadow-*` custom tokens).
5. Compare to PDF §03 layout — the redesigned page mockup. Your spec must produce that exact layout.

## Output format

Markdown. H2 per component. Anatomy as JSON-ish blocks. Token references inline. Tabular state matrices. Embed ASCII layout sketches where it helps Koda see the grid.

End with a "Handoff to Koda" checklist mapping each component to its file path in plan §5.

DO NOT write TSX. Spec only. Sage will review your spec + Pixel's together before Koda begins.
